import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Order.Bounds.Basic

open Nat

theorem rmo_2000_6 :
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 ∧ n = a * b} 10) ∧
  (IsLeast {n | ∃ a b : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2000 ∣ a ^ 3 * b ^ 4 ∧ n = a * b} 10) := by
  constructor
  · -- first set: a²·b⁵ divisible by 2000
    refine ⟨?mem1, ?least1⟩
    · -- witness a = 1, b = 10 gives product 10
      exact ⟨1, 10, Nat.succ_pos 0, Nat.succ_pos 9, by decide, rfl⟩
    · intro n hn
      rcases hn with ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hdiv, rfl⟩
      -- 2 divides a·b
      have h2ab : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h2pow : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ (2000 : ℕ) := by decide
          exact dvd_trans this hdiv
        rcases (prime_two).dvd_mul.1 h2pow with h2a | h2b
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := (prime_two).dvd_pow.1 h2a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left this _
        · have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ b := (prime_two).dvd_pow.1 h2b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right this _
      -- 5 divides a·b
      have h5ab : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have h5pow : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a ^ 2 * b ^ 5 := by
          have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ (2000 : ℕ) := by decide
          exact dvd_trans this hdiv
        have h5prime : Nat.Prime 5 := by decide
        rcases h5prime.dvd_mul.1 h5pow with h5a | h5b
        · have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ a := h5prime.dvd_pow.1 h5a
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left this _
        · have : (5 : ℕ) ∣ b := h5prime.dvd_pow.1 h5b
          exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right this _
      -- 10 divides a·b (using coprimality of 2 and 5)
      have h10 : (10 : ℕ) ∣ a * b := by
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime (2 : ℕ) (5 : ℕ) := by decide
        exact hcop.dvd_mul h2ab h5ab
      -- conclude 10 ≤ a·b
      have hpos : 0 < a * b := mul_pos ha hb
      exact le_of_dvd hpos h10
  · -- second set: a³·b⁴ divisible by 2000
    refine ⟨?mem2, ?least2⟩
    · -- same witness works
      exact ⟨1, 10, Nat.succ_pos 0, Nat.succ_pos 9, by decide, rfl⟩
    · intro n hn
